item.title: Show HN: ADE syncs all your coding agents between web, mobile, and CLI
item.summary: Use any coding subscription you already pay for, in one synced app that runs on web, desktop, terminal, and mobile. All your chats stay synced between all ade surfaces. Run agents from your laptop, continue the conversation from your phone at dinner, then later finish it off from another computer by simply using the web client. All subs, all in one place. Fully free and open source! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49212837 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
